description: This file defines the template class `absl::AnyInvocable`, a type-erased, move-only functional wrapper similar to `std::function`, supporting const correctness, reference qualifiers, and noexcept specifications. It is used for accepting various invocable objects with a specified function signature, providing broad type erasure and ownership semantics.

classes.name: absl::AnyInvocable
classes.description: A move-only, type-erased wrapper for invocable objects with a specified function signature, supporting const, reference, and noexcept qualifiers.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the stored invocable object with the specified signature.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two `AnyInvocable` instances.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Checks if the `AnyInvocable` contains a callable object.
